name: Muhammad Rafli Nurfathan
about_text: Informatics graduate from STIKI Malang (GPA 3.71) with hands-on experience in Web and Mobile Development — building web apps with Laravel, Livewire, and PHP, and Android apps with Kotlin, Clean Architecture, and Unit Testing through Bangkit Academy 2024.
